summary.measurement_qualification: Gzip payload lengths are measured in memory, not saved/decoded archives. Space reclamation is a projection until root preserves/decodes/fsyncs/maps/unlinks all aliases. Allocated projection assumes 4096-byte blocks and excludes map/journal overhead.

producer_mapping.path_encoding: All directories are relative to directory_root. Library paths=directory_root+"/"+directories[directory_ids]+"/libforge_core.a"; object paths=directory_root+"/"+directories[directory_id]+"/"+filename. CMake source_home_ids reference cmake_source_homes.

object_consumer_mapping.current_candidate_path: known library build_root/CMakeFiles/forge*.dir/**/*.o; actual fresh stat, not historical array position

closed_status_basis.root_instruction: All S26 timing and native4+f23 are CLOSED; first S08 native11 PASS; no ASAN build yet. This is scope context, not an assertion all /proc FDs are readable.

process_snapshot.qualification: No global FD-absence claim: proc access denials are explicit. Historical build closure plus no live engine/compiler-name match supports proposal only; root must recheck leases and references immediately before any retirement.

alias_scan.strategy: stat every external regular file regardless of filename; match candidate dev/inode; require discovered aliases == current nlink, otherwise skip. Alias outside root necessarily yields incomplete group.

root_execution_requirements: Proposal only: no archives or original-path mutations performed by this audit.

Use existing seventh/twelfth hardlink archiver pattern only in a newly dated directory after root review; selected groups already use aliases/links/dev/inode/size field names expected by that workflow.

Immediately recheck source/cache provenance, every alias (no symlinks), ownership/mode/mtime/size/dev/inode/nlink, original SHA256, closed leases and all visible proc references. Skip any changed/unknown/incomplete/active group.
Archive each group sequentially using deterministic gzip6, fsync archive, verify exact byte count/SHA with both Python gzip and independent GNU gzip decoders, then fsync archive directory.

Persist all aliases, original hardlink count, per-path mode/uid/gid/atime/mtime, raw SHA256 and archive path/SHA before any unlink; durable map plus append-safe journal and directory fsync are mandatory.

Retire all aliases of the verified inode, asserting nlink decreases exactly; do not touch repo/tracked/evidence originals or any source/main/test/helper executable. Preserve all existing maps/archives.

Inaccessible proc FDs limit a global absence claim. No live engine/compiler process-name matches plus historical source-proven build closure is the bounded proposal basis; parent decides whether additional ownership evidence is required.
